## 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank  
[ Swamy's Central Treasury Rules, Vol. I]  
- family pension through Public Sector family pensioners
1. The facility to draw pension/ Banks is available to all Central Government Pensioners/ including pensioners/ family pensioners of Department of Posts.
